correctness.rationale: For every integer ell>=0, restrict scalar orthonormal spherical harmonics of exact degrees ell and ell+1 to a hemisphere. Longitudinal integration splits into signed orders m; parity makes each available 2x2 concentration block diagonal 1/2 with positive cross-term c_{ell,m}, plus two unpaired 1/2 modes. The associated Legendre Sturm–Liouville Wronskian at the equator gives explicit central-binomial Wallis products c=Q f_j f_k or Q g_j g_k for parities ell+m even/odd. The exact ratios f_{j+1}/f_j=sqrt(1−1/(4(j+1)²)) and g_{j+1}/g_j=sqrt(1+1/(4(j+1)(j+2))) give opposite strict convex/concave m-chain ordering; f_j>sqrt(2/pi)>g_k gives full cross-chain separation. Hence m=ell uniquely maximizes absolute order. a_ell=(2ell+1)sqrt(2ell+3)/(4(ell+1))*binom(2ell,ell)/4^ell decreases from sqrt3/4 to 1/sqrt(2pi); leakage >=1/2−sqrt3/4 with equality at ell=0. Independently computed 253 hemisphere Legendre overlap integrals via Gauss quadrature through ell=21, max absolute discrepancy <1.2e−13; all-degree proof rests on exact recurrence, not finite quadrature.
